subject: English Home Language

source.subtopic: Distinguishes aurally between beginning and end sounds of words

show.line: Words have a first sound and a last sound. Dog starts with d, ends with g. Listen to the end!

rounds.prompt: Cat. What is the last sound? Say it.
Which one ends with n, as in sun?
Hop. What is the first sound? Say it.
Which one ends with p, as in hop?
Which one ends with the same sound as goat?
rounds.praise: Goat, hat. Both end with t.

rounds.prompt: Does the word end with t or g? Sort the pictures.

hints: Say the word slowly. The last sound comes at the very end.
Stretch it out. Caaat. Hear the t?

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will say the last sound in pig.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Pig starts with p. It ends with g.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's say it slowly. Piiig. The last sound is g!

parent_line: Can hear the first and last sound of a short word.
